desc: Ideate approach: parity-based DP for both legs, clockwise direction ordering D=[(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,-1),(-1,1)], turn = (d+1)%4
Define direction vectors and expected-value function (step k: 1 if k==0 else 2 if k odd else 0)
Implement forward DP f[d][i][j][p]: longest valid chain ending at (i,j) along direction d with step-index parity p, rooted at a 1
Implement backward DP g[d][i][j][q]: longest alternating run starting from (i,j) along d where the first step must have parity q
Combine: ans = max over cells/directions/parity of f alone and f[d][i][j][p] + g[(d+1)%4][i][j][1-p] - 1
Handle edge cases: single cell with 1 → 1; no 1 in grid → 0; turn allowed at first cell

Verify solution correctness: fixed stray `fe_next_val` chained assignment, validated traversal order, parity transitions, and combination logic; all 4 examples plus edge cases pass; brute-force cross-check on ~2000 random grids matched
